scope: Six requested learning enhancements and responsive UI repairs for the maintained daily app.

changes.content: Append-only 10 grammar workshops with 80 original exercises and 11 bilingual missions/guided sessions. Totals: 65 workshops, 520 exercises, 67 missions. Existing IDs, programmes and original content remain stable.
changes.chapterChecks: 29 original questions across ten A2 chapter samples, immutable first submissions, saved drafts and targeted prerequisite/workshop/transfer links.
changes.weeklyReport: Dated learning evidence and an optional next-week plan using the saved schedule; self-report and latest-only records are labelled accurately.
changes.listening: Local audio sections, repeat and speed controls, gradual transcript reveal and self-checked dictation; three original device-speech dictations.
changes.progressTransfer: Preview merge/replacement, retain local overlapping first attempts and active work, and detect changed or cleared storage before applying.
changes.offline: Explicit public-app download, manifest, version-pinned offline shell, controlled update activation and removal without clearing learner progress.
changes.layout: Wrapping header/navigation, bounded content and controls, responsive session stages, separated back button and metadata, and focused activity headings after explicit navigation. Supplemental Plus 2 sessions display A2.

privateListeningAndBackupBrowser.generatedAudioEndpoint: Single section pauses at 0.9 seconds; repeat and object URL cleanup verified.

offlineBrowser.result: Offline routes and unfinished work survive reload and explicit release update.

validation.browserMethod: Owned isolated Chromium contexts with synthetic progress and generated audio; shared logged-in browser and real learner data untouched.
validation.privacy: Private source files remain ignored and excluded from the build; local audio/transcripts and connected PDFs are not uploaded or cached by the offline worker.

limitations: Layout checks cover the recorded routes and Chromium configurations, not every browser or possible device setting.
Chapter samples are bounded grammar checks, not a CEFR proficiency assessment.
Private audio, transcripts and listening drafts are tab-local and clear on route leave or reload; they are not included in progress backups.
Home-screen installation availability varies by browser/platform; native installation on every platform was not tested.
Downloaded offline clients stay on their selected release until an explicit update. A server rollback alone does not replace an already downloaded client.
